coverage.scope_history: Initial fabricated tool history cannot authorize movement. Validated authoritative nonstream envelope captured; exact prefix and assistant/call IDs preserved. Incomplete replay 409 is temporary; invalid replay pins. Historical reused ID capture fails closed.
coverage.source_identity: Source authorization unchanged; exact scoped latest completed row required. Duplicate, foreign, historical callbacks rejected. Repeated invocation identities make attribution ambiguous rather than selecting latest. Metadata-only callback creates no interpreter work and clears old advice.
coverage.provenance: All six admitted status literals tested. Arbitrary success-looking output remains executor tool_result text and separate literal tool_status evidence. Protocol completion does not assert execution success.
coverage.configuration: 7 malformed capability configurations rejected with matching valid startup control; absent/false capabilities and quality/cost/advice failure exercised by supplied tests. Protocol requirements accumulate conservatively.
coverage.mandatory_policy: Shadow remains baseline; explicit destination cannot bypass tool owner. Final M2 redirect cannot bypass candidate qualification. Sensitive tool source privacy survives metadata-only revision; unsupported options pin permanently.
coverage.memory: Mutex serializes scope updates; snapshots own deep copies; previous boundary/observed calls freed before dispatch, pending objects released at finish/destroy. ASan/UBSan with leak checks passed.
coverage.oom: Five one-shot wrapper targets per build: pending history, tools, named choice, observed calls, complete replay serialization. Each marker consumed; response passthrough and permanent pin under later fresh advice verified. Original unwrapped binary used for full suites/bridge/ordinary probes.

review_findings.text: Pending exchange is separate from permanent pin; bounded authoritative capture and exact replay guard selection. Incomplete does not consume the boundary.
Tool callbacks use own allowlist, exact current attempt and observed ID, duplicate flag, separate executor status and sticky privacy. Metadata does not synthesize advice.
Nonbaseline candidates require known supported protocol bits alongside ordinary qualification; explicit aliases, shadow mode and final policy retain mandatory fences.

suggestions: Promote independent identity/mode/privacy probes and targeted gateway OOM checks into maintained regression tests.
limitations: Scripted loopback, not real native Hermes timing or real-model semantics, quality, savings or full M3 acceptance.
Targeted gateway faults are not exhaustive allocator-failure coverage; standalone validator sweeps are separate dependency evidence.
No merged-main full-suite result is claimed.
issues_encountered: Initial independent configuration probe expected the wrong diagnostic wording (invalid context configuration versus actual invalid runtime configuration). Corrected the probe assertion, added valid startup control, reran both builds successfully; no implementation change.
